note: THE PAPERCLIP STOPS OPENING A PHONE SHEET ACROSS A DESKTOP. The founder, with a 1920px screenshot: 'if i want to attach something in a chat and press on the paperclip, this is how it opens in the desktop tab. horrible and disgusting.' The cause was one class — `fixed inset-0 z-[300] flex items-end` with NO `sm:` override — and the fix already existed three times in the same file at AdminCommunity.tsx:1523, :1617 and :1652. Measured before and after, in a real Chromium: at 1920px the panel spanned 1920px bottom-pinned and now spans 464px centred; at 380px it is unchanged at 380px and `flex-end`, because the mobile sheet was already correct and breaking it was the overcorrection to avoid. THE-331 OWNS the five files below. It changes NO Firestore query shape, NO send path and NO attachment schema; firestore.rules, firestore.indexes.json, functions/ and src/app/layout.tsx are byte-identical and pinned as literal digests in this ticket's own guard suite, which shells out to nothing. It adds NO npm dependency and NO token, and every one of the 43 installed shadcn primitives is byte-identical — which was not free: the cascader's own `--dry-run` announced it would OVERWRITE button, spinner and scroll-area, so the install was run in a throwaway project and only the cascader modules were copied across.

entries.why: NEW, AND DELIBERATELY PURE. It holds the four record types, their labels and their loaders, lifted out of a useEffect inside AdminCommunity's picker so two screens cannot drift on them. No JSX and no React, so the category list and the recents rule are assertable without mounting a surface. 🔴 A FAILED READ IS A FAILURE: every loader returns a discriminated `AttachLoad`, so a caller cannot reach the rows without reading `ok` first. The old code answered a rejected Firestore query with `setItems([])` and then printed 'No docs yet' — a church that could not READ its contacts was told it HAD none, which is the Silent-Failure Rule exactly. The four categories load INDEPENDENTLY rather than through one Promise.all, so one collection a tenant cannot read does not blank the other three. Every row carries its own `category` because ids are NOT unique across the four collections: a doc and a contact may both be `abc123`, and only the category tells them apart. The labels are frozen — `campaigns` reads 'Fundraising' and nowhere reads 'Campaigns'. Forms still read from the tenant SUBCOLLECTION, which is why dualTenantDocs does not apply to them, and that comment moved with the code.

NEW. The paperclip opens a MENU now, not a sheet, so there is no full-width surface left to mis-place: `dropdown-menu` carries four category submenus, each with two or three REAL recents, a separator, then 'Browse…'. 🔴 `searchScope="deep"` is set EXPLICITLY because the prop defaults to "level", which filters only the level in view and never crosses a category — a guard exercises the real engine and proves one query returns a hit from all four collections with its path annotated, rather than grepping for the string. `mode` stays at its default "drill" (mobile-friendly; "tree" would SILENTLY disable deep search, as the cascader itself warns). 🔴 `virtualize={false}` is pinned OFF against the brief's instruction to leave it automatic: the windowing RENDERER is opt-in and is not mounted, so the automatic flag would flip past 100 rows while `CascaderItems` still rendered rows with no `index`, giving Base UI's O(n) fallback and a dangling aria-activedescendant — broken keyboard navigation and no windowing. That also means `@tanstack/react-virtual` is never reached, so this ticket adds no dependency at all. The commit reads `details.node.data`, a whole record, and cross-checks `details.path[0]` against its category; a bare id is never parsed. `z-[110]` for the menu and `z-[130]`/`z-[131]` for the dialog, because both surfaces default to `z-50` and the bottom nav is `z-[100]` — nothing is raised to the old `z-[300]`. Primitives adopted: dropdown-menu, dialog, button, alert, empty, spinner. `sheet` REJECTED — the entire point is that this stopped being a sheet above `sm`. `command` REJECTED — it is a flat searchable list with no hierarchy and cannot express the path annotation that tells a 'Testing' doc from a 'Testing' form. No emoji and no hardcoded colour.

THE HAND-ROLLED PICKER IS GONE — 182 lines of it. `AttachPicker` was a `fixed inset-0 flex items-end` sheet (a hand-rolled `sheet`), a hand-rolled tab strip, a hand-rolled search input, a hand-spun border-spinner with a hardcoded #d4a017, a hand-rolled empty state and four EMOJI standing in for icons; both composer sites now render `<AttachMenu />`. ChannelMembersSheet, which had the identical `items-end` defect and was NOT named in the brief, is fixed the same way and reported as in scope — it moved from line 491 to 311 as a result, which is why this ticket's layout suite discovers surfaces by PATTERN rather than pinning line numbers. The remaining three emoji, in AttachmentCard and the two attachment chips, are replaced by a shared `AttachTypeIcon` so the picker and the attached chip cannot drift. The six live Firestore listeners, the channel queries and the attachment schema are untouched; the known unrelated Firestore 400 on the `orderBy('createdAt','desc')` Listen stream was not investigated here.

TWO SHEETS GAIN THE `sm:` OVERRIDE THE THIRD ALREADY HAD. The form-attach sheet at :203 and the new-message sheet at :928 carried the same `fixed inset-0 z-[300] flex items-end` with no breakpoint, so both spanned a desktop screen edge to edge; both now take `sm:items-center justify-center sm:p-4` with the panel capped at `sm:max-w-lg` and squared off to `sm:rounded-2xl`. 🔴 Below `sm` NOTHING CHANGED and that is asserted, not assumed: measured at 380px both are still 380px wide and still `flex-end`, because the phone sheet was correct and a guard exists specifically to fail if it is centred. No message send path, no thread query and no gate was touched.

A FIFTH INSTANCE THE BRIEF DID NOT NAME. Sweeping for `fixed inset-0 … items-end` with no `sm:` override found this sheet at :405 alongside the four that were named, carrying the same defect at `z-[200]`; leaving it would have shipped a known-identical bug two files from the fix. It gains the same override and `sm:rounded-3xl` on a panel that already had `max-w-lg mx-auto`. LivestreamView.tsx:391 matches the same pattern and is deliberately NOT changed: it is `lg:hidden`, so it is a phone-only sheet by design and centring it would be the overcorrection this ticket's second guard exists to catch. No blog query, draft state or publish path was touched.
